title: Telangana CM Revanth steps up attack on Rahul Gandhi’s detention; leaders and cadre stage dharnas
description: Telangana Congress cadre and leaders participate in Chalo Raj Bhavan led by TPCC president Mahesh Goud. Ponnam Prabhakar and Jagga Reddy stage dharnas in Husnabad and Sangareddy respectively. Deputy CM protests in Hanamkonda.
